speaker: ChatGPT
text: That line between “can” and “may” is a great place to start. A coworker might know how to send an email, but still needs judgment about when to send it, who should see it, and whether it needs a second look. AI raises the same everyday questions, just in a new wrapper. On this show, we’ll slow those questions down. Not to make them scarier, but to make them easier to talk about around a normal table.
